## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, manly fellow with broad shoulders, curly brown hair, and roguish hazel eyes that can also appear clear and straightforward. Though typically frank-faced with a mouth twisted into a teasing smile, he later appears noticeably pale and thin.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 ch.Weddings P22](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0022)_

## Personality

Gilbert Blythe is a clever, popular young man known for his good nature, high spirits, and zest for life. He possesses strong academic skills, excelling at the top of his class while striving toward High Honors and the Cooper Prize, as well as working toward a First Class teacher's license. Driven by a determination to get the best out of life and put the best into it, he aims to earn his own way through college and complete a medical course to fight disease, pain, and ignorance. His personal ambitions also include a desire to marry [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## History

During his school days, Gilbert Blythe engaged in a fierce academic rivalry with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after she rejected his initial attempt to apologize for taunting her. He joined her in the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) as a young man, often discussing teaching experiences and community plans with her. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decided to remain in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Gilbert gave up his teaching post at the local school so that she could take it, leading the two to become close friends. As a preparatory college initiation ordeal, he paraded the business streets of [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) in a sunbonnet and flowered calico apron. At [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Gilbert orchestrated the freshman strategy to win the annual arts rush, took High Honors in Classics, and won the Cooper Prize. His relationship with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grew strained after he confessed his love in an orchard and she rejected his marriage proposal. Although [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) subsequently avoided him and rumors circulated connecting him to [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), Gilbert eventually visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) following their college graduation and invited her for a walk to Hester Gray's garden. There, he confessed his enduring love, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepted his proposal, leaving them happily engaged.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. ## Quotes

> “All right!” Gilbert sprang into his skiff with an angry color in his cheeks. “I’ll never ask you to be friends again, Anne Shirley. And I don’t care either!”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P34](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0034)

> "It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?"
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)

> "We were born to be good friends, Anne. You’ve thwarted destiny enough. I know we can help each other in many ways. You are going to keep up your studies, aren’t you? So am I. Come, I’m going to walk home with you."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)

> — Gilbert Blythe — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P46](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0046)

> "and I’ve given that up in despair. Levi won’t have it taken down just to vex us. There’s a contrary streak in all the Boulters and it’s strongly developed in him."

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) began as bitter school rivals after he taunted her hair and she hit him with a slate, rejecting his early attempts to apologize [R2, S1]. Over time, Gilbert rescued her when her boat sank during a theatrical game, though she continued to refuse his friendship [R4, S4]. They eventually reconciled to become close friends, academic rivals, and mutually supportive companions through school and college [R1, R2, S7, S10]. Despite Gilbert harbouring deep romantic feelings for her, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejected his initial marriage proposal, straining their relationship even as they remained tied through shared memories and ongoing affection [R3, S26].

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), +39 more_

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

Gilbert maintained a fierce academic rivalry with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) throughout their school years in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as they competed for top marks [R5, S7]. Despite this competition, the two celebrated their mutual scholastic achievements together when Gilbert won the school medal and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) won the Avery Scholarship [S8]. As they grew older, they put their classroom rivalry behind them, transitioning into close friends who shared quiet romantic moments as new chapters of their lives began [S8, S10].

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +9 more_

### [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and Charlie are longtime friends from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who traveled together when moving away for college at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) [R7, S15]. While attending college, they were presumed rivals for the romantic affection of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), a gray-eyed mutual acquaintance [R6]. They frequently spent leisure time in the same social circle, participating in freshman events and going on group autumn walks through the park [S16, S25].

### [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fred-wright--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md) acted as comrades and canvassing partners within their local [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community [R8]. They remained connected through social gatherings, attending the Village Improvement Society's farewell party thrown for Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) [S21]. Gilbert later reunited with [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md) on Diana's wedding day, where Gilbert arrived to escort [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into the ceremony [S22].

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--phil-gordon.md)

Gilbert and [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) were friends and academic rivals competing for top honors in their freshman classes at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) [R10, R11]. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) was a frequent member of Gilbert's social circle during walks and gatherings [S25]. She actively gave relationship advice concerning Gilbert, scolding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejected his proposal and keeping [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) updated on rumors surrounding his social life [R10, S26, S27].
